materials_exhausted.note: Owner-layer re-review opened XML, PDF text, OA package members, DOCX/XLSX supplementary files, locator index, and linked APD6/CAMP/literature rows. Remaining uncertainties are preserved as cautions rather than hidden.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 source re-review repaired the framework-test placeholders. Final acceptance is with cautions because APD6 maps to the primary source with annotation cautions, while CAMP activity maps to the paper but its 31-aa database sequence conflicts with the 47-aa locally supported PBD114/rPBD114 sequence. Raw activity and toxicity values are preserved from local sources; direct mechanism is not overclaimed.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The paper supports antimicrobial phenotype, expression response, structural homology, and physicochemical context but no direct molecular killing mechanism; final mechanism claims are bounded accordingly.
